title: A playful vector world
copy: A 2025 independent poster study created in Adobe Illustrator, with a cheerful character and a party-inspired palette.

title: The character comes first
copy: The supplied Earth character rises first. Only its clipped fingertip is repaired; the rest of this supplied layer is preserved.

title: A grounding gesture
copy: The oval shadow sits below the character, giving the illustrated pose a sense of weight. Its hidden section is reconstructed for this presentation.

title: A frame for the message
copy: The green gradient panel stays beneath the character and its shadow. It groups the original event text, date and device-switch-off message.

title: Colour with a playful purpose
copy: The owner identifies #AD94D9, #A26FBA and #7BBA5B. Purple sets the atmosphere; the green gradient helps the bold text stand out. The owner names The Bold Font.

title: Back to the original
copy: The supplied layers return to the original poster. This is a limited-angle reconstruction, with a generated fingertip repair rather than recovered Illustrator source.
